turns.user: I left my rented house in Coimbatore in June 2022 and the landlord never returned my Rs 50,000 deposit. I only just decided to do something about it. Can I still sue him?
turns.reply:
You left your rented house in Coimbatore in June 2022, which means the landlord was required to refund your ₹50,000 security deposit within one month after vacation of the premises, after making due deduction of any liability of the tenant [[TNRRA2017:s11]]. 

Under the law, the standard time limit to file a suit is three years from when the refund became due in July 2022 [[LIM1963:art55]], [[LIM1963:art113]]. Since the three-year period ended in July 2025 and today is in November 2026, the standard limitation period has expired. 

However, if an acknowledgment of liability has been made in writing and signed by the landlord before the expiration of the limitation period, a fresh period of limitation can be computed from the time of that acknowledgment [[LIM1963:s18]].

To help me understand your situation better:
1. Do you have any written messages, WhatsApp chats, or emails from the landlord in the last three years where they acknowledged owing you the deposit?
2. Do you have a written rental agreement or receipts showing the deposit payment?
